member.name: T:Scanner.Client.ScannerConnection
member.summary: Connects to the OEPS scanner server and receives its validated label messages.

member.name: E:Scanner.Client.ScannerConnection.JsonReceived
member.summary: Raised once per well-formed server message with the original JSON. Versions 1/2/3/C are structured; X carries unvalidated raw text. Subscribe before connecting. Handlers run on the receive loop; keep them short and marshal UI updates.

member.name: E:Scanner.Client.ScannerConnection.LabelReceived
member.summary: Versions 1/2/3/C or raw X. Check IsCommand, IsRaw or LabelVersion before reading version-specific fields.

member.name: M:Scanner.Client.ScannerConnection.ConnectAsync(System.String,System.Int32,System.Boolean,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Connects to the server at the given IP/host and port, or to this computer.
member.param: Server IP address or host name. Ignored (and may be null) when thisComputer is true.
The scanner server's listening port, normally 8765.
Cancels connection establishment, not the subsequent receive loop.

member.name: M:Scanner.Client.ScannerConnection.CloseAsync
member.summary: Closes this client's connection. The same instance can be connected again.
